item.title: Ladybird, the first new browser engine in years, is now available to test
item.description: Ladybird, an independent web browser with a built-from-scratch engine, is finally available for testing. On Monday, Ladybird developer Andreas Kling announced that the browser is launching in alpha on macOS and Linux following more than four years of development. The release makes Ladybird the first browser in years to arrive with an entirely new engine. […]

item.title: Megaspeed, the company at the center of the Jensen Huang scandal, appears headed for a US blacklist
item.description: Megaspeed, which was previously led by Alice Huang, would be barred from doing business with U.S. companies unless those companies attained a special license from the federal government.
